ThunderAlley 3.13.1: illustrated banners
- 20 new illustrated banners in a bold cartoon style: Shadow Step, Ninja Squad, Shuriken Storm, Twin Fangs, Commando Cat, Tag & Bag, Pin Puller, Sarge, Drop Zone, Thunder Tank, Full Send, Iron Eagle, Desert Fox, Night Owl, Lights Out, Flag Bearer, Wire Cutter, Care Package, Bush Ghost and Storm Bolt.
- Each one has its own unlock: knife kills and dog tags for the ninjas, long shots for the snipers, killstreaks, wins, matches, challenges and levels. Find them first in Armory > Banners.
- Fixed: the backup update check (used when GitHub is busy) now always finds the newest download.
